Context: 3. Separate Pool for certain categories of employees

- (c) 'Lady Officers Pool' is maintained separately for allotment of GPRA to married lady officers and single lady officers in the ratio of 2:1. - GIO (1), Rule 27.
- 'Lady Officers Pool' introduced within Secretary Pool (SG) to enable Lady Officers to get accommodation on priority basis, subject to conditions. - GIO (2), Rule 27.
- (d) Secretaries Pool for Secretaries to Government of India in Delhi. A Secretaries Pool shall be maintained to provide residential accommodation to Secretaries. - Rule 30.
